import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from stress import build
rng = random.Random(999)
cases=[]; tot=0

req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('cases',len(cases),'windows',tot,'bytes',len(raw))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native','PYTHONPATH':'/workspace/vendor'})
el=time.time()-t0
print('exit',p.returncode,'time %.2f'%el,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',len(p.stderr))
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
